silhouette.reason: Reads as a mineable asteroid: lumpy body with craters and protruding glowing crystals. The FRONT view still has a flat vertical cut face on one side and the hero shows a soft potato with little faceting.
fixes: replace the large flat fracture plane with 2–3 smaller angled facets so no side reads as a cut wall
deeper craters and one or two boulder-scale lumps to break the potato outline

proportions.reason: Blocky ~11 × 10 × 6.7 m body; within the range of small rubble-pile bodies and different from the other variants.
fixes: one shallow saddle/neck so the body reads as a contact binary like Itokawa

materials.reason: Rock, ore veins and crystals separate by hue and the crystals glow without blowing out. In hero.png the veins are now soft-edged and the regolith carries a faint cell grain, but every sheet.png view still shows the veins stair-stepping in square blocks (per-vertex colour), and the cyan mining stain is a soft haze rather than a deposit.
fixes: carry the per-pixel vein and stain colour into the vertex colour too (or sample it per pixel in every renderer) so the veins stop stair-stepping in the sheet views
break the cell grain with clast variation (larger pale and dark flecks, iron-nickel glints with low roughness): it currently reads as crazed mud more than rock

detail.reason: The horizontal terrace banding is gone from hero.png and a faint cell grain now covers the rock, but at hero distance the body is still a smooth blob; the rubble is cube-like and the crater rims are soft.
fixes: a finer secondary noise octave at LOD0 for rock grain and sharper crater rims (raised lip, steeper inner wall)
rubble as irregular chips (random-plane cut cells) instead of cube-like blocks

wear.reason: Some story: rubble and a cyan stain around the crystal sites. No fresh bright ejecta, no drill scars or tailings, and the crater ages are indistinguishable.
fixes: bright fresh ejecta rays around the youngest crater, darker space-weathered older surfaces
drill scars and tailings piles at the crystal mining sites

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps the outline and the crystals, but drops the orange veins entirely and is faceted, so the colour read shifts from banded to plain grey at the switch.
fixes: keep the 2–3 broadest vein bands at LOD2 as per-face colour on a few larger faces so the colour block survives

technical.reason: QA clean; ~18k / 2k / 340 triangles and 2 draws (body + glowing crystals) are proportionate to a hero rock.
fixes: shrink the sdf bounds to the body extent to cut build time and spend the saved LOD0 budget on crater rims
